events.title: Proposed Ladies Pennant – Availability
events.description: Proposed 2026 Ladies’ Pennant The Games Committee is calling for expressions of interest from members in playing in a proposed Ladies’ Pennant competition in 2026. This will be a separate competition to the SCDBA Open Pennant. This event will be conducted on Mondays, commencing on 27 July and finishing on 14 September . For further details, please contact Bowls Director, Phil on 0488 221055. Please enter your name to the list below if you are interested.

events.title: Tuesday Open Pairs
events.description: Tuesday Open Pairs Please enter your team for this event. If you are a single entry, enter your name in your preferred playing position. If you are a single entry and you can see another single entry listed, enter a team with the listed single entry if you wish. Scroll down to check that your team or name appears on the games list. Please note that entries for each day close at 10.00 am. If you wish to enter after this time, need to cancel or change your entry or, your entry failed to appear on the list, please contact the Social Bowls Coordinator on 0499 167922.
